declaration.question: Does the frozen E-MAX V1, unchanged, behave on data created after it was frozen the way it did in development?
declaration.role: a recording and evaluation contract for forward shadow evidence; forward data is never a selection or optimization dataset

upstream.e_max_m6_verdict: E-MAX-M6 PASS — E-MAX V1 DEVELOPMENT CANDIDATE FROZEN
upstream.e_max_m6_code_identity: result.identity.code of the committed M6 result, recomputed from the committed sources (packages_and_m1_runner + m6_runner)

boundary.development: sessions <= 2026-09-16, frozen; never re-run with forward data
boundary.forward: sessions >= 2026-09-17, append-only; stored under market_data/forward/massive (Drive) and data/runtime/strategy_e_max/forward (repo), never under the development binding

E_BASE_FORWARD.selection: canonical symbol ascending, max 3 (the V1.1 decision seal's own selection)

E_MAX_FORWARD.selection: R1 premarket_rvol descending, ties symbol ascending, max 3, no replacement
E_MAX_FORWARD.breadth: B2: universe_rows >= 100 and h5_rate >= 0.030741 -> 1.5, else 1.0, from the 09:25 seal only

strategies.separation: both are computed from the same 09:25 seal and the same exact bars, and are stored as separate strategy rows; they are never merged

decision_seal.inputs: the E-R1 forward feature context contract, verbatim: daily <= D-1, CS reference <= D-1, splits through D, minute bars starting <= 09:24 ET
decision_seal.base: app.strategy_e_v1_1.decision.seal on the V1.1 DecisionFrame (H5 through Research's mask)
contents: breadth state (universe_rows, h5_count, h5_rate, high_breadth, multiplier)
strategy digests (V1.1 rules, E-MAX V1 rules, forward rules)
decision digest over all of the above
decision_seal.immutability: written once; a second write is refused; reading re-derives the decision digest and refuses a tampered file; nothing after 09:25 enters
decision_seal.incomplete_context: FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE: no seal, no H5 = False, the session is NOT_READY and never enters the forward timeline

LIVE.rule: seal written before 09:30:00 ET from inputs available by 09:25

RECONSTRUCTED.rule: seal built after the close from the same sources truncated at the same cutoffs

evidence_modes.storage: every seal, registry row and session row carries forward_mode and evidence_class; LIVE and RECONSTRUCTED are reported separately and never pooled without the split shown
evidence_modes.live_availability_2026_09_22: NOT AVAILABLE: Massive Stocks Basic serves no same-day session (403 PLAN_TIMEFRAME_NOT_INCLUDED, end is always T-1), so no 09:24 premarket bar exists at 09:25 from the bound source. A LIVE path needs a real-time premarket minute source; using another vendor (e.g. Kiwoom, whose volumes differ from Massive) changes the feature inputs and needs its own source-equivalence contract before any LIVE seal. Until then all forward evidence is RECONSTRUCTED / SECONDARY.

shadow_execution.entry: exact 09:30 ET bar open through E-D2 (build_entry_records); ENTRY_INVALID, no backfill, candidate #4 never promoted
shadow_execution.exit: exact 09:34 ET bar close through E-D3 (resolve_exit_batch); UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL; no other price
shadow_execution.implementation: app.strategy_e_max.capacity.execute(capacity=3) for both strategies; E-MAX then app.strategy_e_max.v1.compose (breadth, then global 2.0x)

cost.scaling: levered net = exposure x (gross - round-trip cost)
cost.model_change: forbidden in V1; a different cost model is a new version and contract

availability_2026_09_22.massive_stocks_basic: quotes / NBBO NOT AVAILABLE (store requirement historical_quotes_spread = UNAVAILABLE on Basic); trades per print NOT AVAILABLE; 1-minute bar volume AVAILABLE
availability_2026_09_22.kiwoom_realtime: FT 10-level quotes observed live (probe 2026-09-17), live only, no history; usable only by a LIVE capture of the sealed symbols, which does not exist yet
availability_2026_09_22.status: 09:30 / 09:34 bar volume RECORDED; bid, ask, spread and prints NOT AVAILABLE

execution_friction.forbidden: bar high-low or any OHLC range is never recorded as a spread
execution_friction.observed_execution_friction_bp: reserved name; computed only once quote or fill evidence exists, as a separate diagnostic; never replaces COST_10BP

registry.append_only: one row set per (strategy, forward_mode, session); a session already present for that strategy and mode is refused, never replaced
registry.rows: every H5 candidate of the session (selected or not), per strategy; rank is the strategy's own priority
registry.no_trade_sessions: a READY session with no standard trade is recorded as a 0-return session (the E-D6 / E-MAX development convention); a NOT_READY session is not a 0 and is absent from the timeline

readiness.rule: READY only when app.strategy_e_v1_1.context.require_complete would accept the session; any reason makes it NOT_READY (FEATURE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE)
readiness.universe: the whole D-1 daily-eligible universe (E1 forward protocol section 13); a partial universe is NOT_READY

checkpoints.n_definition: H5 observation rows over valid forward sessions, the E1 forward registry definition (app.backtest.strategy_e1_forward.checkpoint.CHECKPOINTS and registry.h5_count); both strategies share the same N because they share the seal
checkpoints.mode_split: each checkpoint reports LIVE and RECONSTRUCTED separately

roles.250: early sanity: E-MAX 10 bp sign, paired delta vs E-BASE, R1 selection behaviour, breadth behaviour, tail concentration, data quality, friction availability; no promotion reading
roles.500: first decision checkpoint: is E-MAX worth continued forward verification; a one-shot 5-10 year untouched historical purchase may be reviewed here
roles.1000: per the E1 forward checkpoint contract: diagnostic
roles.2000: per the E1 forward checkpoint contract: the only checkpoint that may promote

checkpoints.restatement: a PASS / FAIL / CONTINUE EVIDENCE statement is made only at a declared checkpoint, each recorded once
checkpoints.promotion_gate: NOT DEFINED in F0; a forward gate for E-MAX (thresholds for its own metrics and for the paired delta) must be frozen as a separate contract before the N = 250 evaluation is first computed; development thresholds (M1 P <= 0.10 and so on) are not copied automatically

paired_vs_e_base: delta = E_MAX session return - E_BASE session return on the same session timeline

forbidden.in_response_to_forward_results: any of the above; a change is E-MAX V2, a separate strategy, and never re-labels V1 forward evidence

historical_purchase.plan: development done -> forward evidence -> N = 500 decision point; if forward evidence holds there, review one 5-10 year untouched historical validation, ONE-SHOT; no further historical is required automatically after it

verdict_rule: UPSTREAM when a development artifact or the M6 provenance does not verify; BLOCK only when the frozen rule cannot be reproduced forward, a post-09:25 input is required, development/forward or E-BASE/E-MAX cannot be separated, or an immutable seal cannot be built; DATA when the path is sound but at least one closed forward session is NOT_READY for missing data; READY otherwise

storage.forward_tree: market_data/forward/massive/{grouped_daily/<year>/<D>.json.gz, reference/CS_<as_of>.json.gz, splits/splits_asof_<D>.json.gz, minute/<DIR>/...} (E1 forward layout), append-only, never inside the frozen USB-HIST-V1 binding
storage.minute_pages: either one page per session <SYMBOL>_<D>.json.gz (E1 layout) or Common Raw range pages <SYMBOL>_<start>_<end>.pNN.json.gz with start >= 2026-09-17 and a .request.json ledger written last
storage.reserved_names: a symbol equal to a DOS device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0-9, LPT0-9) is stored under directory _<SYMBOL>; file names keep the symbol. Found 2026-09-22: CON is D-1 daily-eligible for 2026-09-17 and has no minute directory in Common Raw (raw_fetch skips it), so without this rule every forward session would stay NOT_READY
storage.development_isolation: the development replay reads only the 2,152-file manifest through its symlink view, so forward files cannot enter it; the forward reader reads only dates >= 2026-09-17

collection.start_policy: F0 starts no large collection; running one is an operational decision
collection.cadence: RECONSTRUCTED batches: one minute request can cover up to 50 sessions (raw_fetch CHUNK_SESSIONS), so a weekly batch costs about one call per symbol per week instead of per session

splits_asof.status: needs extension (splits_asof_<D> naming, executions through D)

reference.status: reusable; not limited to the 2-year window
reference.calls: about 6-12 pages per snapshot; the latest <= D-1 is enough

minute.collector: app.backtest.historical_store.raw_fetch (ledger resume, cooldown retry, NOT_AVAILABLE on 403, exact provider bytes, gzip mtime 0)
minute.status: needs extension (forward tree root, reserved-name directory)
minute.calls: one per symbol per batch, whole D-1 eligible universe (about 2,550) plus SPY

rvol_history.status: 2,549 of 2,550 D-1 eligible symbols have Common Raw pages through 2026-09-16 with >= 60 contiguous sessions for 2,544; CON needs a backfill under _CON

execution_quotes.status: needs new collector and a LIVE path (Kiwoom FT), not available on Massive Basic
